description: Run each command from the kit folder. Every one must give the expected exit code and output. Tests that need a clean state say so. Run them after writing the code, and again after any change. Fields: exit = the exit code. stdout and stderr = exact text (ignoring a final newline). stdout_contains and stderr_contains = text (or a list of texts) that must appear. stdout_matches = a regular expression that must match. stdout_json = a JSON object: every key and value given must be present in the JSON the command printed (extra keys are fine, numbers compare equal). Where a command says <temp folder>, use a new empty folder. The sample log check expects 8 entries: run it before the setup note is logged (afterwards it is 9).

tests.name: sample work log chain is intact (proves your hashes match the reference)
calc half up on a tie

worklog_scenario.description: Run with KIT_WORKLOG_DIR set to an empty temp folder. This checks the hash chain from scratch. The expected hash values are computed from the spec in worklog.md.
steps: KIT_NOW='2026-01-05 09:30' ./kit log add client="Test & Co" task="Café design" minutes=90 files="a.pdf, b.pdf"  => prints: logged 2026-01-05-001 (work): Café design
KIT_NOW='2026-01-05 10:00' ./kit log add kind=note notes="hello"  => prints: logged 2026-01-05-002 (note): hello
KIT_NOW='2026-01-06 08:15' ./kit log add task="Next day" billable=no  => prints: logged 2026-01-06-001 (work): Next day
./kit log verify  => OK: 3 entries, chain intact

The first entry must have prev "" and hash "6b27e45ef5f580147e6680165b48aaf19c18212535edd31d650976ccafb3f5bc", which is sha256_hex of the text: {"id":"2026-01-05-001","time":"09:30","kind":"work","client":"Test & Co","task":"Café design","minutes":90,"billable":true,"files":["a.pdf","b.pdf"]}
The second entry's prev must equal the first entry's hash. The third (a new day) must link to the second.
Change the word Café to Cafe in the first day's file by hand, then ./kit log verify  => exit 1, stderr: BROKEN at 2026-01-05.json 2026-01-05-001: entry content was changed after it was written
Delete the second entry from the first day's file, then ./kit log verify => exit 1, BROKEN at 2026-01-06.json 2026-01-06-001: link to the previous entry is broken (entry removed or reordered?)
./kit log add task=x kind=weird => exit 1, stderr starts with: Error:
./kit log add kind=work => exit 1 (task is required)
